nodes.label: Split the programme into its parts

metadata.comment: One calculation, one code node (doctrine 8). Static Data may hand rows as runtime Models rather than plain objects, so plain() unwraps whichever arrives — the same helper Data/Fixture lesson uses.

nodes.label: Who is reading, and about whom

metadata.comment: `reader` has NO DEFAULT, on Data/Strings' `audience` precedent (TASK-L163): an instance that does not say who is reading would otherwise ask for the wrong programme. `learnerId` is read only when the reader is a coach — a learner's own programme takes no parameter at all, so nothing a learner's page sends can name somebody else (L170 §0.6).
components/__cloud__/course. Takes no parameter, uses the server's clock (so a backend-fed /course matches the fixture only until 2026-09-30T22:59:59.999Z — L170).

nodes.label: learnerProgramme — a coach reading one learner

metadata.comment: components/__cloud__/learnerProgramme, role:staff. `now` is NOT sent: the page reads the programme at the server's clock, exactly as the learner's own page does, so a coach and their client never read two different fortnights.

nodes.label: A refusal is nothing to show

parameters.functionScript:
/*
 * A REFUSAL IS NOTHING TO SHOW (TASK-L171 criterion 5). A learner who types
 * /learner is refused by `learnerProgramme`; the page gets no programme rather
 * than waiting on one. The reason is never shown — the backend answers every
 * refusal with one body, so "not yours" and "not there" cannot be told apart.
 */
Outputs.items = [];

metadata.comment: Runs on either call's failure only (its Run is wired).
